title: Silent Hill 4: The Room
synopsis: Team Silent’s fourth Silent Hill — retained as the North American PlayStation 2 disc that closed the original numbered run on this hardware.

custody.physical: Complete in box: case, pressed disc, manual, and original cover insert

curatorNotes:
Silent Hill 4: The Room is the numbered entry that turns the series inward — apartment 302, a hole in the wall, and a structure that argues with the open-town exploration of earlier games. Team Silent and Konami Computer Entertainment Tokyo shipped it as a Konami retail disc; the North American PlayStation 2 serial is SLUS-20873 (September 2004).

The archive keeps this edition because the original Team Silent run is incomplete without it. An shelf that stops at Silent Hill 3 invents a cleaner ending than the discs actually allow.

This filing continues the Silent Hill series authority already opened by the PlayStation original. Later Western remakes and reimaginings remain separate custody questions.
collectionNotes:
Acquired in August 2026 while expanding the PlayStation 2 physical shelf.

The retained copy is the North American PlayStation 2 edition published by Konami (SLUS-20873). It remains complete in box with manual and cover insert, and is kept as the reference copy for this filing.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Sony PlayStation 2; compatible North American PlayStation hardware
preservation.compatibility: Pressed for North American PlayStation 2 consoles. The retained disc remains the primary access copy.
preservation.concerns: Optical-disc aging and surface damage remain the principal risks. The disc is stored upright in its original case under stable, dry conditions; printed materials remain housed with the copy.
preservation.knownRevisions: Released in Japan and North America in 2004; North American PlayStation 2 serial SLUS-20873 (September 7, 2004). Contemporary Xbox and PC editions are neighboring objects. Later budget reissues used revised packaging; this filing records the original North American retail edition.
preservation.availability: The original physical edition is out of print and circulates through the secondary market. No current digital edition replaces this North American reference copy.
